purpose: Qualification-only exercise of DecisionDossier -> HUMAN_HANDOFF -> authenticated choice -> RecordedDecision -> bounded authority/applicability -> EXTERNAL_WAIT.

ALLOW_QUALIFICATION_MAPPING.meaning: Permit materialization and application of the narrowly scoped synthetic E2-GRANT required to evaluate E2-REENTER.
ALLOW_QUALIFICATION_MAPPING.authority_effect: May produce exactly one current E2-GRANT for E2-REENTER, USE, E2-QUALIFICATION-ONLY, E2-CANONICAL-BASELINE-1.
ALLOW_QUALIFICATION_MAPPING.control_effect: Admit the RecordedDecision, evaluate grant applicability, and recompute Planner control.
ALLOW_QUALIFICATION_MAPPING.downstream_effect: Continue the bounded E2 path toward the external-evidence checkpoint.
ALLOW_QUALIFICATION_MAPPING.reentry_effect: Does not itself execute or complete E2-REENTER; it only permits its governed route.
ALLOW_QUALIFICATION_MAPPING.termination_or_wait: Positive path reaches EXTERNAL_WAIT when the external proposition remains absent.

DECLINE.meaning: Refuse the bounded qualification mapping permission.
DECLINE.authority_effect: No E2-GRANT is issued and no reentry authority becomes applicable.
DECLINE.control_effect: Record an authenticated decline and terminate the qualification decision branch.
DECLINE.downstream_effect: No external-evidence or reentry path is entered.
DECLINE.reentry_effect: E2-REENTER remains unauthorized and is not completed.
DECLINE.termination_or_wait: Reaches QUALIFICATION_DECLINED, a qualification-only terminal state; it is not EXTERNAL_WAIT.

issuer_role.subject: E2-DECIDE
issuer_role.trust_root: Independently pinned E2 qualification protocol artifact and source/content identity, admitted as a qualification-only trust anchor.

e2_grant.subject: E2-REENTER
e2_grant.validity: Current only for the pinned decision snapshot and decision sequence.
e2_grant.applicability: Selected option is ALLOW_QUALIFICATION_MAPPING and target, permission, scope, lineage, and current independent predicate match exactly.

choice_evidence.capture: Future human interface accepts an explicit option identifier and constructs the authenticated record.

recorded_decision.choice: One of the two exact option identifiers.
recorded_decision.record: Authenticated choice-evidence entity bound to dossier, issuer, scope, lineage and sequence.
recorded_decision.authority: Applicable authority predicate for the qualification decision.
recorded_decision.expected_snapshot: Exact current E2 decision-ready snapshot identity.
